Pakistani National Sentenced to 27 Years for Plot to Kill Trump

Asif Merchant, a 48-year-old Pakistani national, has been sentenced to 330 months (27.5 years) in prison by a U.S. District Court in Brooklyn. Merchant was convicted for attempting to commit an act of terrorism, specifically a plot to assassinate former U.S. President Donald Trump. Merchant stated that the assassination plot was directed from Iran and that he sought to avenge Iran. The U.S. Justice Department issued a press release regarding the sentencing on November 17.
